rule: groups on one side (an item and its control, a task and its restatement, by `pair`); a group with an item that is in an open file of an earlier version (same normalised question, same drawn entry, or the same words: Jaccard of the token sets of at least leak_jaccard) goes open as a whole; every other group is hidden, so the hidden side holds only items that were never open (eval2_items_a3.split_by_publication)
